Task_Type.reason: Confirmed. This is a single-centre prospective cohort of 201 ALS patients. They are classified with the MBNI framework (NC/MCI/MBI/MCBI/FTD-dem), and the classes are related to tracheostomy-free survival (Kaplan-Meier, Cox HR 5.3 for MCI) and to ALS disease progression (binary logistic regression). 'Disease progression' is ALS functional decline, measured by the monthly ALSFRS-R decline and King's staging (p.2). It is not progressive-vs-stable MCI or MCI-to-AD conversion, and no discrimination figure is reported. In this paper MCI is a predictor label inside ALS, not a population split into converters. T2 is ruled out by 'map to T2 ONLY if the task is explicitly progressive vs stable MCI or MCI-to-AD conversion'. The classification-prognosis association is T4; T6 (descriptive clinical cohort) is also arguable, but T2 is not.
Task_Type.quote: Prognostic value was analyzed using Kaplan–Meier survival curves, Cox proportional hazards models, and logistic regression for disease progression.
Task_Type.supporting_quote: In addition, disease progression was classified according to King's staging system, which evaluates ALS progression across four stages based on the number of regions involved and the need for feeding or respiratory assistance
